Overview.p: Lifecycle rules automatically move objects to cheaper storage classes or delete them after a number of days.
A clean-up robot that moves old files to cheaper shelves and bins the very old ones.
Logs stay in Standard for 30 days, move to Glacier at 90 days, and are deleted after 1 year.
